analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 2 sessions. RSI 67.7→66.2 shows neutral range consolidation, and MACD histogram improvement is slowing. The price pattern of 5-day high < 20-day high and 5-day low > 20-day low indicates a consolidation phase. While the ADX at 27.8 suggests a trend, the slowing momentum indicators signal a lack of further upward momentum.
